description: This file defines the NiaPreferencesDataSource class, which manages user preferences using Android's DataStore, including methods to update and retrieve user settings such as themes, bookmarked news, viewed resources, and onboarding visibility.

classes.name: NiaPreferencesDataSource
classes.description: A class that provides methods to access and modify user preferences stored in DataStore, including theme, bookmarked news, viewed resources, and onboarding settings.

methods.name: setFollowedTopicIds
methods.description: Updates the set of followed topic IDs in user preferences.

methods.name: setTopicIdFollowed
methods.description: Sets the follow status for a specific topic ID.

methods.name: setNewsResourceBookmarked
methods.description: Marks a news resource as bookmarked or not.

methods.name: setNewsResourceViewed
methods.description: Marks a news resource as viewed.

methods.name: setNewsResourcesViewed
methods.description: Marks multiple news resources as viewed or not.

methods.name: getChangeListVersions
methods.description: Retrieves the current change list versions.

methods.name: updateChangeListVersion
methods.description: Updates the change list versions using a provided lambda.

methods.name: setShouldHideOnboarding
methods.description: Sets whether onboarding should be hidden.
